FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which letters say oo in bonjour? (1 mark)
   A. au
   B. on
   C. oi
   D. ou

2. What does 'Je m'appelle Njeri.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. My name is Njeri.
   C. Hi, Kamau!
   D. Pleased to meet you!

3. Which little word goes with 'père' (the father)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. la
   D. les

4. Which little word goes with 'bébé' (the baby)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

5. Which little word goes with 'frigo' (the fridge)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. les
   D. l'

6. What does 'Le ballon est derrière la porte.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a bed.
   B. Put the book on the table.
   C. The bag is in the bedroom.
   D. The ball is behind the door.

7. Which little word goes with 'livre' (the book)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

8. What does 'Le lundi, je vais à l'école.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow it is Thursday.
   B. On Monday, I go to school.
   C. On Thursday, I sing.
   D. Today it is Monday.

9. What does 'Le jeudi, je chante.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Friday, I dance.
   B. Today it is Monday.
   C. On Sunday, I rest.
   D. On Thursday, I sing.

10. Which little word goes with 'gâteau' (the cake)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. les
   D. le

11. What does 'J'ai dix ans.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am ten years old.
   B. Happy birthday!
   C. My birthday is on 12 May.
   D. I sing and I dance.

12. What does 'Je n'aime pas le poisson.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is good for your health.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. I do not like fish.
   D. It is a banana.

13. Fill in: Je ______ une mangue. (I eat) (1 mark)
   A. joue
   B. danse
   C. mange
   D. bois

14. What does 'J'ai deux oreilles.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a nose.
   B. I have two ears.
   C. I have ten fingers.
   D. I have a mouth.

15. What does 'J'ai une bouche.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have ten fingers.
   B. She has black hair.
   C. I have a mouth.
   D. He is tall.

16. What does 'Il y a des nuages.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is windy.
   B. It is raining.
   C. It is snowing.
   D. It is cloudy.

17. Which little word goes with 'soleil' (the sun)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. les

18. Which little word goes with 'temps' (the weather)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. les
   D. l'

19. What does 'Le frigo est dans la cuisine.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is behind the door.
   B. Turn left.
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. Where is the key?

20. What does 'Le lit est dans la chambre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. You are welcome!
   B. The cat is behind the door.
   C. Turn right.
   D. The bed is in the bedroom.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: 'Joyeux anniversaire !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: 'Au revoir, Monsieur.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

23. Translate into English: 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Translate into English: 'Il est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux yeux.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

26. Name the four French accents you have learned and give an example word for each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

27. Sort five foods into good for health and eat little, in French. (5 marks) (5 marks)

28. Translate into English: 'Bon anniversaire !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Translate into English: 'Il y a un orage.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Translate into English: 'Voici ma famille.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux pieds.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — ou
   The letters ou say oo.

2. B — My name is Njeri.
   Je m'appelle Njeri. means My name is Njeri.

3. B — le
   père is masculine, so we say le père.

4. C — le
   bébé is masculine, so we say le bébé.

5. B — le
   frigo is masculine, so we say le frigo.

6. D — The ball is behind the door.
   Le ballon est derrière la porte. means The ball is behind the door.

7. A — le
   livre is masculine, so we say le livre.

8. B — On Monday, I go to school.
   Le lundi, je vais à l'école. means On Monday, I go to school.

9. D — On Thursday, I sing.
   Le jeudi, je chante. means On Thursday, I sing.

10. D — le
   gâteau is masculine, so we say le gâteau.

11. A — I am ten years old.
   J'ai dix ans. means I am ten years old.

12. C — I do not like fish.
   Je n'aime pas le poisson. means I do not like fish.

13. C — mange
   Je mange means I eat.

14. B — I have two ears.
   J'ai deux oreilles. means I have two ears.

15. C — I have a mouth.
   J'ai une bouche. means I have a mouth.

16. D — It is cloudy.
   Il y a des nuages. means It is cloudy.

17. B — le
   soleil is masculine, so we say le soleil.

18. B — le
   temps is masculine, so we say le temps.

19. C — The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Le frigo est dans la cuisine. means The fridge is in the kitchen.

20. D — The bed is in the bedroom.
   Le lit est dans la chambre. means The bed is in the bedroom.
